subject: math
topicName: Trigonometry: Law of Cosines for SAS
description: Apply the Law of Cosines to find an unknown side when two sides and the included angle of a triangle are known.
learningObjectives: Identify when a missing-side problem has SAS information
Explain why the Law of Sines cannot always start a SAS problem
Use c squared = a squared + b squared minus 2ab cosine C to find the side opposite an included angle
Round missing side lengths to a requested precision
Check whether a computed side length is reasonable for the given angle
